name_reason: Follows fd2_<domain>_<descriptor>; descriptor '_dispatcher' is semantic (12-case AI behavior-class dispatch), not an address residue. Canonical name is established across program_info/battle.md, overview.md, _index.md (all reference 'fd2_enemy_turn_action_dispatcher @ 0x13A9F'). It is the per-character AI turn handler; although the team1 NPC path also routes through it, 'enemy' is the project's settled term and renaming would desync the whole KB for no clarity gain.
purpose: Master per-character AI turn handler: selects and runs an action pattern based on the character's AI behavior class (low nibble of runtime_char[+0x34]).
logic_summary: Early-exit if (runtime_char[char_idx].bFlags & 0x05) (dead / cannot-act). Reads ai_class=pChar[0x34]&0x0F, ai_aux_byte=pChar[0x35], target_pos=pChar[0x36], ai_target_id=pChar[0x3d]. Dispatches on ai_class: 0 default attacker (attack_action_dispatch, fallback seek->advance_to_nearest); 1 defensive (attack then seek); 2 aggressive (attack then force score_physical); 3 targeted approach (attack then find_char->pan->walk_to_target_tile); 4 pass-turn (pan+walk preferred dir); 5 item-pickup (attack then scan tile via find_tile_with_attribute_match; on arrival copy tile_event_data (kind,param) into pCombat_aux_block[0x31..0x33], add_item_to_inventory if kind==0, mark consumed flag, sfx, set ai_class=7); 7 charge/dash (pan+walk; if end tile == caster pos mark_char_as_dead); 8 hard skip (return); 9 advance toward specific char (find_char->pan->walk; -1 falls back to case 0); 10 hard-coded attack (attack then pan+walk like case 4); 11 smart caster (score_offensive_spell, execute if best_spell_score>=6; score_physical, execute if best_physical_score>=6 else seek->pass_turn_with_heal). Shared postlude: check_tile_event_post_action(pos_x,pos_y,1), mark_char_acted_this_turn, clear_all_chars_facing, composite_battle_frame(0). Pattern across cases: if the chosen movement/walk returns 0 (no action taken) then ai_pass_turn_with_heal as idle fallback.

params.name: char_idx
params.semantics: Index into data_fd2_battle_runtime_char_array_ptr of the acting character (caller passes its per-turn loop index). Used to compute pChar = base + char_idx*RUNTIME_CHAR_SIZE and forwarded to every AI callee.
params.reason: Accurate runtime-char array index; no address residue.

params.name: team
params.semantics: Team / context flag forwarded verbatim to all AI callees (attack_action_dispatch, ai_seek_optimal_position, ai_walk_to_target_tile, scoring/execute fns). Caller fd2_enemy_turn_phase_team0 passes 0 (bTeam==0 enemies); fd2_npc_turn_phase_team1 passes 1 (bTeam==1 allied NPCs) -- the value is literally the acting team number.
params.reason: src name 'team' precisely reflects the caller-supplied team number (0 vs 1); more accurate than the Ghidra plate's generic 'ctx_flag'; no address residue.

returns.semantics: No return value. Side effects only: mutates runtime_char state, inventory, tile-event consumed flags, animation phase, and renders the final battle frame.

notes: src logic verified equivalent to decompilation; the Ghidra decompiler renders the case-7 post-walk guard as a dead 'if (ai_class == 0)' but disassembly @0x13d53 (TEST EAX,EAX after CALL fd2_ai_walk_to_target_tile @0x13d4b) confirms it guards on the WALK return value, which the src faithfully translates as 'if (result == 0) fd2_ai_pass_turn_with_heal'. Case-11 plate says '> 5' / src says '>= 6' -- arithmetically identical (asm CMP ...,0x6 / JL). No logic issue. src comment block (lines 460-467) is concise and correct; Ghidra plate carries the detailed per-case breakdown and is consistent with src understanding, so plate left untouched. writes_globals: data_fd2_field_map_tile_event_consumed_flags_ptr is the base pointer; case 5 writes through it (consumed_flags[ai_target_id]=1). Reads/writes of pCombat_aux_block and bPickup fields are via the runtime_char_array_ptr base.
